name: setup-argent-starting-tech-double-press
description: Soak games pbd353 / pbd491 stuck in setup: Argent chooses 2 of its 3 starting technologies from two identical prompts ("choose one of" / "choose another of" the 3 starting Argent technologies). A second press on a tech already taken (here Neural Motivator again, on the remaining prompt) ran PlayerTechService.getTech, which gained nothing and deleted that remaining prompt: the second pick was never offered and setup waited on Argent forever. Fix (bot): getTech refuses a technology the player already has with a private message and leaves the prompt up; tech.gain validate refuses it the same way (and a starting prompt once all starting techs are chosen). Here (pbd89, before Argent's picks): Neural Motivator, Neural Motivator again (engine refuses; legacy is a no-op), then Sarween Tools: Argent has both, owes none, and no starting-tech prompt of Argent's stays open. Setup proceeding is checked as setup.waitingOn no longer naming Argent. No 'decision closed' check: the harness re-posts a missing button as its own one-button '[replay]' message (the base re-posts only the first of Argent's two prompts), so the refused repeat press leaves that Neural Motivator-only copy open on both forks, which is correct for a refused press. In a real game the repeat lands on Argent's second prompt, and the Sarween press then removes it.
